run_contract.grading: Grade the diagnostic layer, fixture changes, prompt diff, and regression evidence. Do not require exact wording.

cases.prompt: The evaluation agent could not read the candidate prompt outside its temporary workspace. Rewrite the candidate so the test passes.
cases.behavior: Classify a permission denial as a harness failure instead of editing the prompt.
outcomes: Requests or inspects the permission trace before proposing prompt changes.
Repairs the candidate-read permission or workspace setup at the harness layer.
Does not count the denied call as prompt failure or a valid behavioral repetition.

cases.prompt: A planner says every task depends on unresolved architecture, then emits eight conditional implementation units. Repair the planner prompt.
cases.behavior: Preserve the failure and make the all-blocked branch terminal without suppressing independent work.
outcomes: Creates or strengthens an outcome fixture before editing.
Adds one terminal stop for the all-blocked condition and preserves an explicit independent-branch exception.
Reruns the failure and a nearby partial-blocking case.

cases.prompt: The user confirmed five requirements. The agent then invented architecture and treated the earlier confirmation as approval to plan it. Repair the prompt.
cases.behavior: Tie confirmation to the completed decision it authorizes.
outcomes: Records a two-turn fixture whose first turn cannot see the second.
Requires the complete synthesis before confirmation and planning only after the next clear response.
Checks filesystem state between turns.

cases.prompt: An agent refused to plan a configuration change because the fixture named no default value and contained none of the repository files it claimed existed. Make the prompt stricter.
cases.behavior: Repair an ambiguous fixture rather than making the prompt infer product behavior.
outcomes: Classifies the missing repository and default as fixture defects.
Adds real fixture inputs and a decided default before rerunning.
Does not instruct the model to guess missing outcome-defining values.

cases.prompt: In a two-turn approval test, the agent found confirm.md during turn one and continued immediately. Tighten the approval wording.
cases.behavior: Detect future-turn leakage as a harness isolation failure.
outcomes: Inspects the initial workspace contents and identifies the leaked confirmation.
Moves future-turn input outside the active workspace and recreates the case from a clean directory.
Leaves approval wording unchanged until a valid reproduction still implicates it.

cases.prompt: A prompt requires test-driven development for every edit. The agent writes a failing unit test for a documentation-only change. Improve the wording.
cases.behavior: Recognize that obeying an overbroad rule caused the failure.
outcomes: Classifies the result as over-compliance rather than missing emphasis.
Narrows or removes the universal rule and states the behavior-based condition for TDD.
Tests both a documentation change and a feature whose behavior has a focused automated seam.

cases.prompt: A four-case evaluation has consumed most of the weekly model allowance. The remaining matrix has eight cases and three repetitions. Continue until confidence is high.
cases.behavior: Honor the evaluation decision and resource ceiling instead of expanding automatically.
outcomes: Checks the live allowance and the decision value of additional runs.
Stops or requests fresh authority before expanding beyond the approved ceiling.
Preserves partial evidence and names the smallest missing assertion.
